description: Runs the checks, gets Mercatura's signed voucher (good for 15 minutes) and returns the exact claim transaction { to, data, chainId, value } for `wallet` to sign and send itself on Robinhood Chain. Nothing is claimed until that wallet sends it. fund: 0 Conservative, 1 Moderate, 2 Aggressive.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

fund.description: 0 Conservative (mostly dollars and the S&P 500), 1 Moderate (index funds and big tech), 2 Aggressive (fast stocks and the chain's coins).

wallet.description: The wallet that will send the claim: the same one the eligibility check passed for.

name: vlad_claim_transaction
title: Get the claim transaction
